senses.sense_definition: Relating to or characterized by abnormal physical development or malformation of body parts.

examples.text: The infant was born with <w>dysmorphic</w> features that required immediate genetic testing.
Doctors identified several <w>dysmorphic</w> characteristics during the physical examination of the patient.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to a psychological condition involving an obsessive focus on perceived flaws in one's physical appearance.

examples.text: She struggled with <w>dysmorphic</w> thoughts that made her avoid looking in mirrors.
The therapist specializes in treating patients who suffer from body <w>dysmorphic</w> disorder.
